formula: u=d-2**(n-1); Q=P-[2**(n-1)]G; g=(Qx+Qy) mod p; score=Pearson(phi(u), phi(g)); phi=factoradic lead frac; FORBIDDEN: any Q==[u]G or P==[d]G check; no lead-width sweep
domains: d in band [2**(n-1),2**n); u in [0,2**(n-1)); Qx,Qy,g in F_p
score_definition: Pearson corr of phi(u) vs phi((Qx+Qy) mod p) over puzzles 1..70
null_families: random (n-1)-bit payloads with random field coords
trivial_exclusion_justification: Uses u and both Q coordinates via g=(Qx+Qy) mod p; not implied by curve equation; must collapse if Q is permuted among payloads.
